title: Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models adapt to new datasets through in-context learning (ICL), and, like most transformers, they tie computational depth to the number of independently parameterized layers. We ask whether the ICL stage of such a model needs a distinct set of parameters for every layer, or only depth. We introduce Tab-Loop, which replaces the 12 untied ICL blocks of TabICLv2 with 4 tied blocks applied $k$ times and changes nothing else: the encoders, decoder, synthetic prior and training recipe are shared with an untied baseline trained for the same compute. At matched pretraining compute (18.2 EFLOP) and matched inference compute (12 block applications), Tab-Loop matches the baseline with 62\% fewer parameters (10.4M vs.\ 27.6M): held-out log loss is 0.4583 vs.\ 0.4588, mean accuracy on 200 TALENT datasets is 84.10\% vs.\ 83.92\%, and Elo on 38 TabArena datasets is 1409 vs.\ 1396. A 4-block untied control with Tab-Loop's parameter

translated_title: 面向表格基础模型的循环上下文学习
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习（ICL）适应新数据集，并且与大多数Transformer一样，它们将计算深度与独立参数化的层数绑定在一起。我们探究这样一个模型的ICL阶段是否需要为每一层配备一组独立的参数，还是仅仅需要深度。我们提出了Tab-Loop，它用4个参数共享（tied）的块循环应用k次来替换TabICLv2的12个参数不共享（untied）的ICL块，其他一切保持不变：编码器、解码器、合成先验和训练方案均与在相同计算量下训练的非共享参数基线保持一致。在匹配的预训练计算量（18.2 EFLOP）和匹配的推理计算量（12次块应用）下，Tab-Loop以减少62%的参数量（1040万 vs 2760万）达到了与基线相当的性能：留出集对数损失为0.4583 vs 0.4588，在200个TALENT数据集上的平均准确率为84.10% vs 83.92%，在38个TabArena数据集上的Elo得分为1409 vs 1396。一个具有Tab-Loop参数量的4块非共享对照模型……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出Tab-Loop方法，用4个参数共享的块循环应用来替代表格基础模型中参数不共享的多层ICL块，在匹配计算量的前提下将参数量减少62%且性能不降。
en_tdlr: Tab-Loop replaces untied ICL blocks in tabular foundation models with 4 recurrently-applied tied blocks, matching baseline performance with 62% fewer parameters at matched pretraining and inference compute.
